title: Square Garden Plot
statement: A gardener has n square tiles and wants the biggest square plot she can lay with them, side × side tiles. Return the largest whole side length s with s × s <= n, without a square-root function.

keyPoints: The answer is between 0 and n
s × s <= n is true for small s and false for large s
Find the largest s where it holds; use 64-bit products
edgeCases: The largest n, where s × s overflows 32 bits

hints: The answer is a number between 0 and n. Does "s × s <= n" flip only once as s grows?
Yes: true, true, …, true, false, false. Binary search the last true.
Keep lo..hi; compare mid × mid with n using a 64-bit product to avoid overflow.
